items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: Well here’s what drummer Ed Shaughnessy had to say.

ctx.x: Swing is hard too, You know I’m still trying to get it together.

Well here’s what drummer Ed Shaughnessy had to say. I asked him what is swing and he went on for quite a while so I’ll just — he says, “Now I think bluegrass music swings like hell. The main thing that swing means for me is it’s infectious, a beat that makes you want to move, it gets you going. So any music like bluegrass or jazz or funk or Watusi music communicates to you rhythmically and gets a visceral thing going. That’s what I think swing is.”
